verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares does ship automations, such as Gusto-driven equity grants, an automatic data room, and generative workflows, so asking whether they can be versioned, reviewed, and rolled back is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack documents no version history, change review, or rollback for any of these automations or workflows. Saved predefined vesting schedules are reusable templates, not versioned automations, so they earn no credit.
